title: Viva Glint: enhanced multi-attribute report exports
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap details, current export behaviour, licensing and administrator assignment path are supported. One descriptive statement should be narrowed: Microsoft promises increased supported scale, but does not say this means larger attribute combinations.
